title: Assessing reliability of explanations in unbalanced datasets: a use-case on the occurrence of frost events
reasoning: The paper is a technical study focused on the robustness and consistency of Explainable AI (XAI) methods when applied to unbalanced tabular datasets. It evaluates these properties using a meteorological use-case (frost events) and does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
